decisions.reason: Ending the contract and approved-clip publishing does not change the general rules governing permitted source material.
The contract termination does not revise or cancel the content standard requiring complete standalone teaching moments.
The source ends the contract but does not modify the defined submission channels, folder rules, or review workflow as general process requirements.
The source contains no decision about clip length or the unresolved shorter-clip policy.
The contract termination does not revise the historical qualification method or criteria, and no attribute-level consequence is entailed.
Ending approved publishing does not alter the caption color, font, effects, lettering, or positioning standards.
The source does not change the clean-editing, visual-effects, or transition requirements.
The same source explicitly reinforces the communication expectation and its failure; removing publishing does not make that expectation obsolete.
The contract termination does not change the standard for selecting strong and impactful source moments.
The source does not revise or invalidate the requirement to remove distracting wind noise from clips.
